$comment: OBS3 — b2c-concierge dashboard, versioned in git for portability across Langfuse projects/instances (Best Practices: dashboards/widgets export as JSON, {"$langfuseWidget": true, ...}). Each widget entry below carries its FULL chart definition (view/dimensions/metrics/filters/chartType) so it is re-creatable from scratch via createDashboardWidget + createDashboard + addDashboardPlacement even on a fresh project — the widgetId/dashboardId fields are this project's live IDs, kept only as a reference, not required to re-import. Built live on 2026-07-30 against project cms4gd0d20002nz029tuly62e via the langfuse MCP server (createDashboardWidget/createDashboard/addDashboardPlacement) — this file mirrors getDashboard's real output, it is not a hand-written guess.

dashboard.name: b2c-concierge — OBS3 deterministic scores
dashboard.description: TTFT, latency, degradation levels, empty-shortlist rate, the 13 guard_* series, LLM-budget breaches, cost by model.

widgets.name: TTFT p95 (ms)
widgets.description: OBS3: time-to-first-token, p95 across turns — CLAUDE.md SLO is progress < 300 ms.

widgets.name: Empty shortlist rate
widgets.description: OBS3: share of turns where hotels_returned == 0 — the audit's "recherche vide" gisement, now measured continuously.

widgets.name: Turns exceeding the 3-call LLM budget
widgets.description: CLAUDE.md structural invariant (<= 3 LLM calls/turn) — count of turns where llm_calls > 3, should stay at zero.

widgets.name: Guard firing rate (13 series)
widgets.description: OBS3 §2: one bar per guard_* score name — the fréquence de déclenchement par guard the 2026-06 audit couldn't answer.

widgets.name: Latency p95 by observation name
widgets.description: OBS3 §8: p95 latency broken down by observation name (guards/tools/generations) — the debug-priority list.

widgets.name: Observation count by level
widgets.description: OBS2: the daily debug queue — a level:ERROR/WARNING count is the guard/degradation frequency at the observation grain.

widgets.name: Cost by model
widgets.description: OBS2 addendum: totalCost per model, post the call_llm double-count fix (2x -> 1x) — the number this dashboard now shows should be the real one.

known_gaps: The `degraded` CATEGORICAL score has no widget yet — its score config creation is blocked by an MCP tool bug (see score-configs.json known_gaps); revisit once that's created.

The guard firing rate widget only shows data for the 8 guards the concierge actually emits today (recovery_ack, anti_clarification_loop, amenity_truthfulness, named_hotel_lookup, booking_confirmation, hotel_link_truthfulness, budget_integrity, timeslot_sanitization) — the 5 geo/date guards live in hotel_search_agent, out of OBS3's zone, and are not wired for emission yet.
